meta.title: Dorian Poncelet — Cybersecurity & GRC
lang.label: Language
hero.eyebrow: GRC Analyst · Junior GRC Consultant · Secure Infrastructure Administrator
hero.lead: Owner of a local retail business since 2014, retrained in cybersecurity. I connect risk governance and compliance with hands-on infrastructure skills and AI-driven automation, backed by documented, verifiable projects.
seq.title: Approach: from infrastructure to governance
seq.1.p: Multi-site infrastructure, 12 Terraform virtual machines, 10 Ansible playbooks, Wazuh SIEM, network segmentation and VPN — a complete training lab, documented end to end.
seq.2.p: A working SOC built on Wazuh: log source integration, detection tests through simulated attacks, rule tuning.
seq.3.p: An information security management system for a fictional SME: CISO Assistant deployment, automated ISO 27001:2022 deliverables, NIS 2 and GDPR mapping.
gov.title: From technical controls to decisions.
gov.lead: During a cybersecurity consulting internship for a non-profit, I produced the full set of engagement reports (ISO 27001, NIS 2, GDPR, NIST CSF) with Green Shield, the tool I designed. A risk only matters once it is measured, prioritised and explained to the people who decide — without ever inventing a finding.
skills.title: What I can do, and how I prove it.
skills.lead: No gauges or percentages: each skill states whether it is demonstrated by a public project, practised in training or during the internship, or currently being learned.

pulse.lead: Every day, a pipeline I wrote reads cybersecurity news, summarises it in French, writes a radio script and reads it aloud with speech synthesis.
contact.title: Let's talk security.
contact.lead: Available immediately. Based in Rodez (France), travelling and working remotely across the country. Open to any offer: permanent, fixed-term, freelance or assignment. CV on request via LinkedIn.
